text_en: Then he commanded the steward of his house, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in the top of his sack.
text_cn: 然后若瑟吩咐自己的管家说：“将粮食装满这些人的布袋，他们能带多少，就装多少；将每人的银钱仍放在他的布袋口处，

text_en: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the top of the sack of the youngest, with his money for the grain. ” And he did as Joseph told him.
text_cn: 再将我的银杯和那最年幼购粮的银钱，一并放在他的布袋口处。”管家就照若瑟吩咐的话做了。

text_en: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away with their donkeys.
text_cn: 清早天一发亮，就遣送这些人带着他们的驴走了。

text_en: When they had gone only a short distance from the city, Joseph said to his steward, “Go, follow after the men; and when you overtake them, say to them, ‘Why have you returned evil for good? Why have you stolen my silver cup?
text_cn: 他们出了城，还不很远，若瑟就对他的管家说：“你起身去追赶那些人，追上他们，就对他们说：你们为什么以恶报善？

text_en: Is it not from this that my lord drinks? Does he not indeed use it for divination? You have done wrong in doing this. ’”
text_cn: 为什么偷去我的银杯？这杯是我主人为饮酒为占卜用的啊！你们作的实在不对！”

text_en: When he overtook them, he repeated these words to them.
text_cn: 管家追上他们，就对他们说了这些话。

text_en: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!
text_cn: 他们回答说：“我主怎么说些这样的话？你的仆人们决不敢做这样的事！

text_en: Look, the money that we found at the top of our sacks, we brought back to you from the land of Canaan; why then would we steal silver or gold from your lord’s house?
text_cn: 你看！我们在布袋口所发现的银钱，还从客纳罕地带回来给了你，我们怎能偷你主人家的金银呢？

text_en: Should it be found with any one of your servants, let him die; moreover the rest of us will become my lord’s slaves. ”
text_cn: 在你仆人中，不论在谁那里搜出来，谁就该死，并且我们都该作我主的奴隶。”

text_en: He said, “Even so; in accordance with your words, let it be: he with whom it is found shall become my slave, but the rest of you shall go free. ”
text_cn: 管家答说：“也好，就照你们的话做；只是在谁那里搜出来，谁该作我的奴隶；你们其余的人可自由离去。”

text_en: Then each one quickly lowered his sack to the ground, and each opened his sack.
text_cn: 于是他们各人急忙将自己的布袋卸下，放在地上，各人打开自己的布袋。

text_en: He searched, beginning with the eldest and ending with the youngest; and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
text_cn: 管家便一一搜查，从年长的开始，到年幼的为止；结果那杯在本雅明的布袋里搜了出来。

text_en: At this they tore their clothes. Then each one loaded his donkey, and they returned to the city.
text_cn: 他们遂撕裂了自己的衣服，各人又使驴驮上重载，回城里去了。

text_en: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house while he was still there; and they fell to the ground before him.
text_cn: 犹大和他的兄弟们进了若瑟的家，若瑟还在那里，他们就在他面前俯伏在地。

text_en: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Do you not know that one such as I can practice divination? ”
text_cn: 若瑟对他们说：“你们作的是什么事？难道你们不知道像我这样的人会占卜吗？”

text_en: And Judah said, “What can we say to my lord? What can we speak? How can we clear ourselves? God has found out the guilt of your servants; here we are then, my lord’s slaves, both we and also the one in whose possession the cup has been found. ”
text_cn: 犹大答说：“我们对我主还能说什么？还有什么话可说？我们如何能表白自己？天主已查出了你仆人们的罪恶。我们和在他手里搜出杯来的，都应作我主的奴隶。”

text_en: But he said, “Far be it from me that I should do so! Only the one in whose possession the cup was found shall be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father. ”
text_cn: 若瑟答说：“我决不这样做；在谁手里搜出杯来，谁就该作我的奴隶；至于你们，都可平安上去，回到你们父亲那里。”

text_en: Then Judah stepped up to him and said, “O my lord, let your servant please speak a word in my lord’s ears, and do not be angry with your servant; for you are like Pharaoh himself.
text_cn: 犹大近前对若瑟说：“我主，请原谅，容你仆人向我主进一言，请不要对你仆人动怒，因为你原与法郎无异。

text_en: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father or a brother? ’
text_cn: 我主以前曾问仆人们说：你们还有父亲或兄弟吗？

text_en: And we said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a young brother, the child of his old age. His brother is dead; he alone is left of his mother’s children, and his father loves him. ’
text_cn: 我们曾回答我主说：还有老父和他老年生的幼儿；他的哥哥死了，他母亲只剩下了他一个；为此父亲非常疼爱他。

text_en: Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, so that I may set my eyes on him. ’
text_cn: 你就对你仆人们说：将他带到我这里来，我要亲眼看看他。

text_en: We said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die. ’
text_cn: 我们即对我主说：孩子是不能离开他父亲的；如果离开了，他父亲必会死去。

text_en: Then you said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall see my face no more. ’
text_cn: 你对你仆人们说：如果你们的小弟弟不同你们一起下来，你们休想再见我的面。

text_en: When we went back to your servant my father we told him the words of my lord.
text_cn: 我们一上到你仆人，我父亲那里，就将我主的话告诉了他。

text_en: And when our father said, ‘Go again, buy us a little food, ’
text_cn: 后来我们的父亲说：你们再去给我们买点粮食来。

text_en: we said, ‘We cannot go down. Only if our youngest brother goes with us, will we go down; for we cannot see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us. ’
text_cn: 我们答说：我们不能下去；除非我们的小弟弟同我们一起，我们才下去；因为我们的小弟弟不同我们在一起，我们不能见那人的面。

text_en: Then your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons;
text_cn: 你的仆人，我的父亲就对我们说：你们知道，我的妻子给我只生了两个儿子：

text_en: one left me, and I said, Surely he has been torn to pieces; and I have never seen him since.
text_cn: 其中一个离开我出去，我猜想，他是被猛兽撕裂了，到现在，再没有见到他。

text_en: If you take this one also from me, and harm comes to him, you will bring down my gray hairs in sorrow to Sheol. ’
text_cn: 如今你们连这一个也要由我面前带走；倘若他遇到什么不幸，你们就要使我这白发老人在悲痛中下到阴府了！

text_en: Now therefore, when I come to your servant my father and the boy is not with us, then, as his life is bound up in the boy’s life,
text_cn: 现在，如果我回到你仆人，我父亲那里，孩童没有与我们在一起，──他原与这孩童相依为命，──

text_en: when he sees that the boy is not with us, he will die; and your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to Sheol.
text_cn: 他一见孩童没有与我们在一起，就必死无疑；那你的仆人们就要使你的仆人，我们的父亲带着白发在忧苦中下入阴府了。

text_en: For your servant became surety for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I do not bring him back to you, then I will bear the blame in the sight of my father all my life. ’
text_cn: 况且你的仆人曾在我父面前为孩童担保说：如果我不将他带回来交给你，我终生在我父前负罪。

text_en: Now therefore, please let your servant remain as a slave to my lord in place of the boy; and let the boy go back with his brothers.
text_cn: 现在请让你的仆人留下，代替孩童给我主为奴，让孩童跟他哥哥们回去。

text_en: For how can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? I fear to see the suffering that would come upon my father. ”
text_cn: 如果孩童不与我在一起，我怎能上去见我父亲？我怕看见我父亲遭到不幸！”
